acts.act: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (Act No. 5 of 1908)

orders.text:
SA 181/2016
Hon’ble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Mr. Kanta Prasad, Advocate, for 
the appellants. 
Having heard learned Counsel of 
the plaintiffs/appellants, I find that 
there are concurrent judgments under 
challenge in this second appeal. So, 
before admitting this appeal, I think it 
proper to issue notice to the 
respondents/defendants. 
Let steps be taken within a 
week. 
Summon the LCR. 
List soon after service is 
effected. 
 (Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.) 
 23.11.2016 
Prabodh

orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Rajiv Sharma,Hon'ble Mr. Justice Alok Singh,Hon'ble Mr. Justice Manoj Kumar Tiwari
orders.text:
SA No. 181 of 2016
Hon’ble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Mr. Kanta Prasad, Advocate for 
the appellants. 
Respondent nos. 1/4, 3 & 4 still 
have not been served. So, the learned 
counsel of the appellants is hereby 
directed to take steps within a week for 
ensuring sufficient service upon these 
respondents then list this matter in the 
same caption. 
 (Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.) 
 21.3.2017 
Pooja/A.Kaur
